page.layout: Running head at top: page number 154 and the title "ARCHELOGIÆ CAP. XXVII." (right of the number). One text column at right, two paragraphs. Left margin: a note beside the first two lines ("Membra corporis principalia:"), then four notes below it, beside the blank lower text area ("Cerebrum", "Spiritus a-nimalis.", "Imago objecti intelligibilis.").; One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Below the text, at the right, the catchword "Nullus". Right edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: In utroque notabis & materiale, & for-male. Cerebrum Spiritus a-nimalis. Imago ob-jecti intel-ligibilis.
Caput est membrum principale, continens instrumenta tùm Intelligendi, tùm Intellecta confervandi, tùm confervata exterius signifi-candi.
Instrumentum intelligendi est tùm mate-riale, tùm formale.
Materiale est vel continens, vel conten-tum.
Continens est cerebrum: quod est siccum vel humidum, frigidum vel calidum.
Contentum est spiritus animalis: qui aliàs dicitur intellectualis.
Formale est imago objecti intelligibilis, re-præsentata in spiritu animali sive intellectuali.
Imago ista est vel prima, vel secunda: & u-traq; vel incomplexa, vel complexa.
Imago prima est realis & immediata: putà lapidis, arboris, quæ est incomplexa; vel ferri igniti, quæ est complexa.
Imago secunda est normalis, & mediata: putà generis, nominativi casus, Zodiaci, quæ est imago incomplexa: & axiomatis, syllogismi, methodi, quæ est imago complexa.
Instrumentum intellecta confervandi est itidem materiale, & formale.
Cerebellum est postica cerebri pars, sedes memoriæ.
Imago ob-jecti memo-ria,..Formale est, imago objecti memorialis.

page.notes: The four left-margin notes stand beside the blank lower part of the text area, after the last printed line, so they are placed at the end of the second paragraph. "Cerebrum" is set in bold type. The "ob-" and "intel-" hyphens in the last note are printed hyphens at line ends. Short specks in the left margin beside the lines "Continens" and "Formale" are ink marks, not text. The reading of the margin note "Imago ob-jecti memo-ria" is partly worn; the last word is read as "ria,.." with some doubt.
